archive_policy: Keep standard checkpoints locally; force-track explicit receipts/config/ordered exact-byte archive parts <=9000000 bytes, never commit any file >10000000 bytes
failure_policy: INCOMPLETE or failure preserved; no automatic retry, shorter row, changed settings or semantic rescue
fit_on: Only accepted FIT source-fit-cal-20260908-04/query2, preview row14; never reused adapter for later training
outer_observation: monotonic before spawning the supervisor through confirmed supervisor process exit; includes final lifecycle publication and exit tail
outer_ownership: register observer and supervisor PID; supervisor launched with start_new_session=True, its own model child inherits this process group
outer_timeout: At 600 seconds kill only that owned process group, preserve incomplete/timeout evidence and actual elapsed cost; never retry
pass_requires: Supervisor exit0, inner lifecycle COMPLETE and confirmed model-child exit, all registered numerical/resource/receipt checks, outer elapsed <=600 seconds, plus subsequent independent result audit
